verses.text: Praise the LORD! Praise the name of the LORD! Praise him, you servants of the LORD,
you who serve in the house of the LORD, in the courtyards of the house of our God.
Praise the LORD, because the LORD is good. Sing praises to his name, because that is a joy.
The LORD has chosen Jacob to be his own, Israel to be his special treasure.
I know that the LORD is great, that our Lord is greater than all gods.
The LORD does whatever he wants in heaven and on earth, in the seas and in all the deep waters.
He makes clouds rise from the ends of the earth. He sends lightning with the rain. He brings the wind out of his storerooms.
He struck down the firstborn of Egypt, both people and animals.
He sent miraculous signs and wonders among you, Egypt, against Pharaoh and all his officials.
He struck down many nations and killed mighty kings:
Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan.
He gave their land as an inheritance, an inheritance to his people Israel.
LORD, your name lasts forever. LORD, your fame lasts for all generations.
The LORD will defend his people and show mercy to his servants.
The idols of the nations are made of silver and gold. Human hands made them.
They have mouths, but cannot speak. They have eyes, but cannot see.
They have ears, but cannot hear. There is no breath in their mouths.
Those who make idols will become like them, and so will everyone who trusts in them.
Family of Israel, praise the LORD! Family of Aaron, praise the LORD!
Family of Levi, praise the LORD! You who respect the LORD, praise the LORD!
Praise the LORD from Zion, the one who lives in Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!
